question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**broken up**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage refers to the life cycle of Banana.
 
• Now, the blank 5 will explain how the reaction between the fruit and ethylene breaks the chlorophyl inside the banana.
 
• Thus, among the given options, the correct phrase to use in the blank is** "broken up."**
 
 
• **"Broken up"** means to separate or divide something into smaller pieces.(टूटना)
 
• This phrase is often used to describe relationships or groups that have ended or disbanded.
 
 
• ​**Example**: *Their marriage had **broken up**__ as a result of long separations. *
 
 
 
 
 
• ​In the context of the sentence, it suggests that something was previously whole or intact but has now been separated or fragmented.
 
• ​Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

__
 
• Correct passage:

The life cycle__ of a banana is a colourful one; it starts with a deep green, changes to a delicious yellow and ends at an unappetizing brown. Bananas, like most fruits, produce and __react__ with an airborne hormone called ethylene. This hormone helps to signal the ripening process. An unripe fruit is hard and acidic. It is likely to possess a greenish __hue__ due to the presence of chlorophyll. When a fruit comes into contact __with__ ethylene, the acids in the fruit start to break down, it becomes softer and the green chlorophyll is __**broken up**__ and replaced, in the case of bananas, with a yellow hue. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Option 2, "brought to",** suggests that something was taken to a particular place or condition.(किसी चीज़ को किसी विशेष स्थान या स्थिति में ले जाया गया।)

 
 
• **Example**:* The package was **brought to**__ my doorstep.*
 
 
 
• **Option 3, "fallen into"**, implies that something has deteriorated or declined.(कुछ बिगड़ गया है या गिरावट आ गई है।)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The building has **fallen into**__ disrepair.*
 
 
 
• **Option 4, "turned down"**, means to reject or refuse something.(किसी चीज़ को अस्वीकार करना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *I **turned down**__ the job offer.*
